QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` (`:85`) puts the value through `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` when `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined... The point is that the compiler cannot prove the value is 0 or 1, so it cannot rewrite the mask logic into a conditional jump.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` with a read-write register operand and says it exists so the compiler can't optimise the mask into a branch. It doesn't say outright that no instruction is emitted, but an empty asm string implies that.
